nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the cloud relay service: a slim node:24 base with corepack-pinned pnpm, a build stage that installs workspace deps and compiles the relay package, and a runtime stage that ships the built dist plus Prisma schema and runs migrations before booting the bootstrap server on port 4310.
nodes.languageNotes: Build context is the parent cloud/ directory (pnpm workspace root), so COPY paths like 'relay/' and 'wire/' resolve from there. Runtime stage installs libssl because the slim base lacks openssl, which Prisma needs to silence its version-detection warning.

nodes.name: base
nodes.summary: Shared base stage on node:24-slim that pins pnpm via corepack and sets /app as the working directory; reused by the build and runtime stages.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Build stage that copies workspace manifests and source for the wire and relay packages, runs pnpm install with a frozen lockfile, then runs the filtered build for @pactify-apps/relay.

nodes.name: runtime
nodes.summary: Runtime stage that sets NODE_ENV=production, installs openssl for Prisma, copies compiled dist, node_modules, prisma assets and prisma.config.ts from the build stage, exposes port 4310, and CMD runs prisma migrate deploy followed by node dist/server-main.js.
